fact: The Deputy Minister of Health said the ministry would proceed with digitising 500 primary care units under a protocol with Vodafone Egypt, starting with Cairo governorate, with 2,000 USB modems requested for primary care units.
title: نائب وزير الصحة يؤكد على سرعة الانتهاء من ميكنة المنشآت الطبية بالقاهرة
